<thought>All measured resistances are consistent with a single series chain from node A to node B with multiple tap points. By ordering the nodes according to their resistance measured from A, the individual segment resistances are obtained:

- A‑X1 = 6.667 Ω  
- X1‑N_b1 = 5 Ω  
- N_b1‑X2 = 13.333 Ω  
- X2‑N_c1 = 5 Ω  
- N_c1‑N_c2 = 10 Ω  
- N_c2‑N_c3 = 15 Ω  
- N_c3‑X3 = 20 Ω  
- X3‑N_d1 = 5 Ω  
- N_d1‑N_d2 = 10 Ω  
- N_d2‑N_d3 = 15 Ω  
- N_d3‑B = 20 Ω  

These eleven resistors (R1‑R11) in series sum to 125 Ω, matching the A‑B measurement, and reproduce every other node‑to‑node resistance within the allowed tolerance. The required JSON describing the topology is therefore:

{
  "resistors": {
    "R1": 6.667,
    "R2": 5,
    "R3": 13.333,
    "R4": 5,
    "R5": 10,
    "R6": 15,
    "R7": 20,
    "R8": 5,
    "R9": 10,
    "R10": 15,
    "R11": 20
  },
  "connections": [
    ["A","X1","R1"],
    ["X1","N_b1","R2"],
    ["N_b1","X2","R3"],
    ["X2","N_c1","R4"],
    ["N_c1","N_c2","R5"],
    ["N_c2","N_c3","R6"],
    ["N_c3","X3","R7"],
    ["X3","N_d1","R8"],
    ["N_d1","N_d2","R9"],
    ["N_d2","N_d3","R10"],
    ["N_d3","B","R11"]
  ]
}

This JSON follows the required submission format.</thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors":{"R1":6.667,"R2":5,"R3":13.333,"R4":5,"R5":10,"R6":15,"R7":20,"R8":5,"R9":10,"R10":15,"R11":20},"connections":[["A","X1","R1"],["X1","N_b1","R2"],["N_b1","X2","R3"],["X2","N_c1","R4"],["N_c1","N_c2","R5"],["N_c2","N_c3","R6"],["N_c3","X3","R7"],["X3","N_d1","R8"],["N_d1","N_d2","R9"],["N_d2","N_d3","R10"],["N_d3","B","R11"]]}</final_answer>
